During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''battle''' occurred in the village of [[Chakton]]. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces under the command of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[334.556/G7]] clashed with [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] forces led by Commander [[Thickston Deke]].
